messages:
Jin (Procurement): AeroShip flagged a weight limit on the H200 pallet for PO R-993. They propose splitting into two AWBs. Air expedite option ETA ~36-48h with surcharge; consolidated sea+road ETA ~4-6 days. Need quick decision 
AeroShip: Hi team — we can split. Two AWBs: AWB-7788001122 and AWB-7788003344. Air expedite surcharge estimate $2,200 incl brokerage. If you accept, we can manifest tonight. Photos + serials sent to procurement@redwood.
Nora Ops: We have a patch deploy Thursday needing 6 H200s in FRA. 4-6 days misses the window. Air seems necessary unless we pull from other pools.
Eli (Finance): Can vendor absorb the expedite? If not, what's the net cost vs SLA penalty for missing commitments?
Jin (Procurement): @AeroShip can you confirm if you will credit the expedite fee if units are DOA on arrival? Also need invoice wording to be 'warranty replacement - no commercial value' and HS code.
AeroShip: We can credit expedite fee if units are DOA on arrival and issue CN-471 once RMA confirmed. HS code 8471.80.10. Invoice wording accepted.
Marco (SRE): Important: some target nodes run firmware 1.4.1. If replacements arrive with 1.3.x we'll need depot reflash ~3-5h per device. That eats our prep window. Please request FW >=1.4.1 or include refurb cert.
AeroShip: Noted. We will prioritise units with FW 1.4.1+ where available; otherwise refurb cert included and we'll mark units as refurbished.
Eli (Finance): Given SLA risk, approve air split if AeroShip covers $2.2k expedite or issues credit note pre-shipment.
Jin (Procurement): Agreed. Conditions: 1) AeroShip issues credit or absorbs expedite, 2) invoice marked warranty/no commercial value, 3) FW >=1.4.1 or refurb cert. Please upload AWB scans and CN-471 to the tracker.
AeroShip: Confirmed. We'll absorb expedite fee and upload AWB scans + CN-471 to portal within 2h. AWBs below:
``
AWB-1: AWB-7788001122
AWB-2: AWB-7788003344
``
Nora Ops: Thanks. I'll reallocate staging and notify oncall for depot prep in case we need reflashes.
Jin (Procurement): I'll update the PO and notify Finance to expect the credit. Marking thread resolved once docs are in tracker.
